note: Oracle for forge's audit manifest v1 (§6/§8/§9, issue #15) — the trust deliverable. Hand-derived (R-CHAR-3). The manifest is a pure projection of the cert collection; the oracle asserts the STABLE structure: per-fn levels + assurance_scope, the project assurance (min level + scope), and the TCB enumeration (slag U boundary U toolchain). contract_quality shape is asserted; version-sensitive ratios + solver_time_ms are excluded (per-cert precedent). manifest_version == v1.

cases.name: corpus_empty_tcb
cases.why: sum/spec_sum are pure-Thermite, L3, end-to-end -> project L3 end-to-end; the TCB has NO slag and NO boundary (only the toolchain identity). The fiat-trusted base of a pure project is exactly the toolchain.

cases.name: slag_boundary_tcb
cases.program: #[slag(reason = "hand-tuned", owner = "agent:x", review = "required")] fn vendored(x: u32) -> u32 req x < 100 ens result == x fx pure { x } #[boundary("ext::ext_f")] fn ext_f(x: u32) -> u32 req x < 100 ens result == x fx pure ;
cases.why: TCB enumeration: the slag block `vendored` (with reason/owner/review) AND the boundary contract `ext_f` (target ext::ext_f) BOTH appear in the audit manifest's TCB (§8 grep-slag inventory + §9 boundary contracts). Nothing fiat-trusted omitted (R-DEFER-9).
